fierre.name: Serafierre val Lischelle-Drakle

canon_ref.note: Called Fierre at the Huntress' Haven (6.00); full name Serafierre val Lischelle-Drakle at chapter end. Vampires cannot gain classes or levels (6.01).

fierre.summary: A young Vampire in Reizmelt who works as an envelope opener and alchemist's helper. After taking Ryoka to her family's keep when Ryoka guesses her nature, she becomes Ryoka's close friend.

colfa.name: Colfa val Lischelle-Drakle

canon_ref.note: Seen at the end of 6.00; named Lady Colfa in 6.01. Born Human of the Lischelle farming family, she lost her classes when Himilt turned her into a Vampire.

colfa.summary: Fierre's mother and mistress of House Lischelle-Drakle. Born Human, she puts on grand old vampire airs and has a strong dominating gaze, though an arm rash troubles her.

himilt.name: Himilt val Lischelle-Drakle

canon_ref.note: Seen at the end of 6.00; named Himilt Drakle / Lord Himilt val Lischelle-Drakle in 6.01. Vampires hold no classes.

himilt.summary: Fierre's steady father and Colfa's husband. Dressed like a working farmer, he tends sheep and repairs the masonry of their ruined keep despite a chronic swelling under his jaw.

rivel.name: Rivel

canon_ref.note: Present in the rafters at the end of 6.00; named Rivel in 6.01 as Fierre's brother.

rivel.summary: Fierre's brother, the only one of her surviving brothers still living at the Drakle keep.

bamer.name: Bamer

canon_ref.note: Seen coughing in the rafters at the end of 6.00; named Bamer in 6.01 as the oldest Vampire Fierre knows.

bamer.summary: An elderly Vampire living with the Drakle family, weakened by age and a lifelong cough.

madain.name: Madain

canon_ref.note: Nicknamed Mad Madain. An [Innkeeper] and retired [Javelineer] of a Gold-rank team (6.00). Race not stated (guess).

madain.summary: The gruff owner of the Huntress' Haven in Reizmelt, who wakes his boarders at dawn with a pan so he can spend the day hunting fresh game.

alber.name: Alber

canon_ref.note: Regular boarder at the Huntress' Haven (6.00); class [Fist Fighter] stated, level and race not stated (guess).

alber.summary: A stocky, self-taught [Fist Fighter] who boards at the Huntress' Haven and fights challengers in a Reizmelt street ring for coin.

alime.name: Alime

canon_ref.note: Receptionist at the Reizmelt Runner's Guild with a bad leg (6.00, 6.01). Race not stated (guess).

alime.summary: The polite [Receptionist] of Reizmelt's Runner's Guild, who walks with an injured leg and dispatches Ryoka on her northern runs.

kelysta.name: Kelysta

canon_ref.note: An elderly [Alchemist] in Reizmelt who employs Fierre (6.00, 6.01). Race not stated (guess).

kelysta.summary: An old, stain-tattooed [Alchemist] in Reizmelt who employs Fierre at her shop and worries over the girl's cough.

levil.name: Levil

canon_ref.note: Captain of the Silver-rank Pithfire Hounds; called both a [Pyromancer] and a [Mage] (6.00, 6.01). Race not stated (guess).

levil.summary: The warm-handed [Pyromancer] captain of the Silver-rank Pithfire Hounds, whom Ryoka helps rescue from Wailer Frogs in the marsh.

lord_beilkit.name: Lord Beilkit

canon_ref.note: A minor northern [Lord] of House Malt in Blaiseford's Lookout who receives a courting letter via Ryoka (6.00). Unseen in person; race is a guess.

lord_beilkit.summary: A minor northern [Lord] of House Malt at Blaiseford's Lookout whose family wealth comes from sheep estates.

quelm.name: Quelm

canon_ref.note: One of Octavia's rival [Alchemists] in Celum (6.02). Race and level not stated (guess).

quelm.summary: A scrawny Celum [Alchemist] who copies and improves Octavia's match formula until she throws a burning bottle through his shop window.

elissa_slipscal.name: Elissa Slipscal

canon_ref.note: An older orange-scaled Drake in Liscor who corrects the Human spelling 'Slipscale' to 'Slipscal' (6.08). No class stated.

elissa_slipscal.summary: A bossy older Drake of Liscor who blocks Lyonette in line at the Watch and demands action against rent-gouging landlords.

kel.name: Kel

canon_ref.note: A Drake [Guardsman] stationed with Nevvim at Pallass's seventh-floor door to Liscor (6.09).

kel.summary: An uptight Pallass [Guardsman] at the magic door who tries to charge Erin the five-gold entry tax before Captain Venim steps in.

nevvim.name: Nevvim

canon_ref.note: A Drake [Guardsman] guarding the Liscor door on Pallass's seventh floor beside Kel (6.09).

nevvim.summary: Kel's partner on door duty in Pallass, who asks Captain Venim if they should arrest Erin after she threatens Venim.

lorent.name: Lorent

canon_ref.note: A Pallass-born Dullahan [Sharpener] and [Shopkeeper] who sells Maughin's knives (6.09, 6.13K).

lorent.summary: A dour Dullahan knife [Sharpener] in Pallass who startles Erin by setting his head in a counter basket while his body fetches stock.

grimalkin.name: Grimalkin

canon_ref.note: A muscle-bound Pallass [Mage] of physical magic who drills apprentices on the stairs (6.09) and watches the smiths' contest (6.13K).

grimalkin.summary: A hugely muscular Drake [Mage] of Pallass who teaches physical magic and salutes Erin's courage on the city stairs.

maughin.name: Maughin

canon_ref.note: A giant Dullahan master smith on Pallass's ninth floor (6.09, 6.10); states he is a Level 35 [Armorer] in 6.13K.

maughin.summary: A giant Dullahan [Armorer] on Pallass's ninth floor who backs the door-tax protest and repairs Pelt's discarded masterwork knife for Erin.

pelt.name: Pelt

canon_ref.note: Mentioned in 6.05D; appears on Pallass's ninth floor in 6.09 and 6.13K. Higher level than Level 35 Maughin, exact level not stated.

pelt.summary: A gruff, hard-drinking Dwarf master [Smith] in Pallass who forges a miraculous knife for Erin in under an hour, then tosses it aside over a tiny flaw.

xif.name: Xif

canon_ref.note: A nose-blind City Gnoll [Alchemist] who runs Cunning Crafts on Pallass's ninth floor (6.09, 6.10).

xif.summary: An eccentric, dye-stained City Gnoll [Alchemist] in Pallass who rallies his guild for door access after tasting Erin's Acid Flies.

melinni.name: Melinni

canon_ref.note: A white-scaled Drake [Butcher] who owns Melinni's Meats on Pallass's fourth floor (6.09, 6.10).

melinni.summary: Pallass's wealthiest [Butcher], a friend of Rufelt and rival of Lasica who rallies the city's meat sellers against the door tariff.

rufelt.name: Rufelt

canon_ref.note: City Gnoll co-owner of Tails and Scales with his Drake wife Lasica (6.09, 6.10). Holds an unnamed advanced [Bartender] class past Level 30.

rufelt.summary: A warm, perceptive City Gnoll [Bartender] who runs Tails and Scales in Pallass with his Drake wife Lasica and comforts a grieving Erin.

lasica.name: Lasica Feltail

canon_ref.note: Purple-scaled Drake [Chef] and [Cook] who runs Tails and Scales with her Gnoll husband Rufelt (6.09, 6.10); past Level 30.

lasica.summary: A brisk, purple-scaled Drake [Chef] who runs the kitchen of Tails and Scales with her Gnoll husband Rufelt and helps Erin fight the Pallass door fee.

saliss_of_lights.name: Saliss of Lights

canon_ref.note: Seen outside Tails and Scales being hauled off by the Watch for nudity; Lasica calls him Pallass's resident Named Adventurer (6.10). No class stated in Book 10.

saliss_of_lights.summary: Pallass's eccentric resident Named Adventurer, a slim yellow-scaled Drake whom Erin first spots being arrested outside Tails and Scales without his clothes.

rissa_inkscale.name: Rissa Inkscale

canon_ref.note: Liscor's best [Scribe], with the Skill [Illustrator's Vision] (6.11). Level not stated.

rissa_inkscale.summary: A temperamental yellow-and-blue-scaled Drake [Scribe] in Liscor whom Ilvriss hires to sketch Az'kerash's undead.

jeckl.name: Jeckl

canon_ref.note: A Gnoll [Scribe] in Liscor hired off-screen by Olesm and Welsca to copy Olesm's chess magazine (6.11).

jeckl.summary: A reasonably priced Gnoll [Scribe] in Liscor who copies Olesm's chess magazine under oath of secrecy.

lawes.name: Lawes

canon_ref.note: Salazsar's Drake [Spy] (or [Infiltrator]) stationed near Pallass for seven years; keeps Ilvriss's black mana stone door in a village hut (6.11). Not ylawes_byres.

lawes.summary: An unassuming Drake [Spy] for Salazsar who rents a hut outside Pallass to anchor Ilvriss's secret black mana stone door.

veel.name: Veel

canon_ref.note: A Level 26 [Sword Captain] in Ilvriss's retinue, brought into his secret cell against Az'kerash (6.11).

veel.summary: The strongest fighter in Wall Lord Ilvriss's Liscor retinue, a seasoned [Sword Captain] trusted with the secret war against Az'kerash.

rudss.name: Rudss

canon_ref.note: A retired veteran of Liscor's army who chats with Ilvriss on the street beside Tekshia (6.11). No class stated.

rudss.summary: An opinionated retired Drake army veteran in Liscor who sits in the street with Tekshia and chats with Wall Lord Ilvriss.

bealt.name: Bealt

canon_ref.note: A City Gnoll [Farrier] and [Smith] on Pallass's ninth floor whose offer to make Erin a knife sparks the contest with Pelt and Maughin (6.13K).

bealt.summary: A friendly City Gnoll [Farrier] on Pallass's ninth floor whose boast of fast work sets off a smithing contest between Pelt and Maughin.

caroline.name: Caroline

canon_ref.note: A 19-year-old Australian Earther who gives Kenjiro her romance manuscript to test-sell, then vanishes overnight from a roadside inn near Talenqual (6.04D).

caroline.summary: An Australian Earther and aspiring writer whose sudden disappearance from a roadside inn drives Daly and Geneva's group to leave Gravetender's Fist.

blake.name: Blake

canon_ref.note: A 19-year-old New Zealand Earther rescued from an abandoned hill village with Nicoletta, Lorenzo, and Diana (6.05D); suggests repeating crossbows to Paige (6.06D).

blake.summary: A young New Zealand Earther who survives for weeks in an abandoned Baleros hill village with three Italian companions until Daly's Bushrangers rescue them.

eldima.name: Eldima

canon_ref.note: Female Dullahan captain of the Silver-rank Rustless Guard in Talenqual; clashes with Daly in 6.04D, then is rescued by the Bushrangers at the serpent dungeon in 6.06D.

eldima.summary: The Dullahan captain of Talenqual's Silver-rank Rustless Guard, who goes from Daly's rival to a grateful ally after the Bushrangers save her team.

kiltem.name: Kiltem

canon_ref.note: A Dullahan [Warrior] in Eldima's Rustless Guard whose crushed bones Geneva sets before giving him a healing potion outside the Talenqual dungeon (6.06D).

kiltem.summary: A Dullahan [Warrior] of the Rustless Guard whom Geneva treats after a giant serpent mauls him outside the Talenqual dungeon.

hastel.name: Miss Hastel

canon_ref.note: A pregnant Centaur [Landlady] in Talenqual who rents apartments to the Earthers (6.05D) and is saved by Geneva's emergency Caesarean section (6.06D).

hastel.summary: A Centaur [Landlady] in Talenqual who rents an apartment house to the United Nations company and survives a breech birth thanks to Geneva's surgery.

rital.name: Rital

canon_ref.note: A Cat-tribe Beastkin and Miss Hastel's partner, who runs to fetch Geneva when Hastel's labor fails (6.05D, 6.06D).

rital.summary: A Cat-tribe Beastkin in Talenqual and the devoted partner of the Centaur [Landlady] Miss Hastel.

kirana.name: Kirana

canon_ref.note: An Indian Earther and [Cook] for the United Nations company in Talenqual (6.04D - 6.06D); level under 15.

kirana.summary: An Indian Earther who runs the kitchen and household supplies for the United Nations company in Talenqual.

ilhmet.name: Ilhmet

canon_ref.note: A red-robed [Councilor of State] of Germina who leads the Quarass's rebirth ritual in Ger and picks the three blood-oath witnesses (6.12K).

ilhmet.summary: Germina's [Councilor of State], who presides over the ancient blood ritual in Ger to awaken the reborn Quarass.

the_quarass.name: The Quarass

canon_ref.note: After Flos beheaded the old Quarass (4.06KM), she is reborn in a young Germinan girl in Ger with all past Quarasses' memories via the [Quarass] class (6.12K). One entity.

the_quarass.summary: The immortal ruler of Germina, reborn in a child through a blood oath in Ger with all her predecessors' memories intact.

vaitsha.name: Vaitsha Zectiou

canon_ref.note: A young Germinan [Highborn] who swears the first blood oath on the stones of Ger at the Quarass's rebirth (6.12K).

vaitsha.summary: A young [Highborn] noblewoman of Ger chosen as one of the three blood-bound guardians in the Quarass's rebirth ritual.

khalid.name: Khalid

canon_ref.note: A scarred street boy of Ger with no surname who swears the second blood oath at the Quarass's rebirth (6.12K).

khalid.summary: A brave, scarred street boy of Ger who swears a blood oath at the Quarass's resurrection and becomes her bound companion.

calliope.name: Queen Calliope

canon_ref.note: Widow of King Treland and [Queen] of Hellios; refuses to bow to Flos in Blalevault and abdicates—losing her [Queen] class—to spare her son Siyal (6.12K).

calliope.summary: The grieving [Queen] of Hellios who wages a war of vengeance against Flos Reimarch, then abdicates her throne to save her son and people.

bezha.name: Bezha

canon_ref.note: Formally Bezhavil; elder clanswoman of Clan Tannousin and aunt to Nawalishifra, Silmak, and Hesseif in Reim (6.12K - 6.14K).

bezha.summary: An elder clanswoman of Clan Tannousin who oversees the caravan's womenfolk on the journey to Reim and backs Nawalishifra at the forge.

silmak.name: Silmak

canon_ref.note: A young [Shaman] of Clan Tannousin who speaks for the caravan in Reim and casts the airless forging circle for Nawalishifra (6.13K, 6.14K).

silmak.summary: A young [Shaman] of Clan Tannousin who serves as spokesman for Nawalishifra's caravan and powers the airless rune circle for her smithing.

hesseif.name: Hesseif

canon_ref.note: A big shaved-headed [Warrior] of Clan Tannousin who guards the Naq-Alrama steel wagon and assists Nawalishifra in Reim (6.13K, 6.14K).

hesseif.summary: A massive [Warrior] of Clan Tannousin who guards the clan's Naq-Alrama steel and helps set up Nawalishifra's furnace in Reim.

daiton.name: Daiton

canon_ref.note: Master [Blacksmith] of Reim's royal forges who challenges Nawalishifra to a one-day sword-forging duel (6.13K) and sees her blade survive Flos's hammer test (6.14K).

daiton.summary: The loyal master [Blacksmith] of Reim's royal forges, famed for mass-producing steel weapons for Flos's armies, who tests his craft against Nawalishifra.

chaita.name: Chaita

canon_ref.note: Chaita of Keymos, a Garuda Courier called the Sky's Mirage who once saved Drevish as a Street Runner and carries Flos's peace scrolls across Chandrar (6.14K).

chaita.summary: An emerald-and-white-feathered Garuda Courier known as the Sky's Mirage, the only Courier who answers Flos's call to carry his peace edict.

raelt.name: King Raelt

canon_ref.note: Mentioned in 6.14K; appears in 6.15K as [King] of Jecrass (born a [Prince]), clashing with his River Wardens and accepting Flos's peace.

raelt.summary: The sharp-tongued, pragmatic [King] of Jecrass who despises his greedy River Warden nobles and accepts Flos's peace terms to spare his realm.

orjin.name: Orjin

canon_ref.note: The Strongest of Pomle, a [Martial Artist] who keeps the peace at the oasis summit and stops the rulers' battle by force (6.15K).

orjin.summary: A formidable [Martial Artist] titled the Strongest of Pomle, who reluctantly enforces the oasis nation's neutrality at the southern rulers' summit.

salii.name: Salii

canon_ref.note: A brown-scaled Drake [Secretary] who runs Pomle's affairs alongside Orjin and duplicates the Emperor of Sands' secret letter (6.15K).

salii.summary: A dusty-brown-scaled Drake [Secretary] who manages anarchic Pomle alongside Orjin and organizes the eight-nation summit.

nsiia.name: Empress Nsiia

canon_ref.note: Empress of Tiqr, called the [Empress of Beasts]; speaks well of Flos at Pomle and faces a nine-nation declaration of war against Tiqr (6.15K).

nsiia.summary: The bold [Empress of Beasts] of Tiqr, who rides her Grand Elephant to the Pomle summit and refuses to join the coalition against her old ally Flos.
